            for (int i=0; i<n; i+=len){
                for (int j=0;j<half;j++){
                    double angle= angleIncrement*j*(invert?-1:1);
                    double wRe= Math.cos(angle);
                    double wIm= Math.sin(angle);
                    double uRe= real[i+j];
                    double uIm= imag[i+j];
                    double vRe= real[i+j+half]*wRe - imag[i+j+half]*wIm;
                    double vIm= real[i+j+half]*wIm + imag[i+j+half]*wRe;
                    real[i+j]= uRe+vRe;
                    imag[i+j]= uIm+vIm;
                    real[i+j+half]= uRe- vRe;
                    imag[i+j+half]= uIm- vIm;
                }
            }
        }

        if (invert){
            for (int i=0; i<n; i++){
                real[i]/=n;
                imag[i]/=n;
            }
        }
    }
}
